incident.classification: A.16.1.5 — Response to information security incidents

detection_and_containment.detected_by: SENTINEL IPS v2.0 — automated ML + signature detection
containment_actions: Malicious source IPs automatically blocked via OS firewall
Rate limiting applied to suspicious traffic flows
Session tokens for potentially compromised accounts revoked

eradication_and_recovery.root_cause: External attacker exploitation -- automated response engaged
eradication: Block all identified malicious IP ranges at perimeter firewall
Reset passwords for all accounts accessed during the incident window
Identify and clean all C2-beaconing endpoints
Patch OpenSSL and revoke/reissue TLS certificates
eradication_and_recovery.recovery_status: Automated response completed; manual review recommended

corrective_actions: Update IDS/IPS signatures with patterns from this incident
Review and tighten firewall and WAF rules
Engage threat-hunting team for deeper investigation
Implement network micro-segmentation to limit lateral movement
Enforce MFA on all externally-facing authentication endpoints
preventive_measures: Adaptive model retrain scheduled to improve future detection
Zero-day patterns added to threat intelligence feed
Attacker profiles updated for future correlation
